meta.name: autoresearch
meta.description: Orchestrates end-to-end autonomous AI research projects using a two-loop architecture. The inner loop runs rapid experiment iterations with clear optimization targets. The outer loop synthesizes results, identifies patterns, and steers research direction. Routes to domain-specific skills for execution, supports continuous agent operation via Claude Code /loop and OpenClaw heartbeat, and produces research presentations and papers. Use when starting a research project, running autonomous experiments, or managing a multi-hypothesis research effort.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动管理研究项目：先搜索文献、形成假设，然后反复做实验、记录结果，定期总结发现并调整方向，最后生成论文和演示文稿。整个过程不需要你批准，它会自己推进。
howto.when: 当你提出一个研究想法或明确的研究问题，或者想启动一个自主实验项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究一下 Transformer 的注意力机制为什么在长序列上效率低。
say.note: Claude 会启动文献搜索、形成假设并开始实验循环。

say.text: 继续我之前暂停的关于模型压缩的研究。
say.note: Claude 会读取保存的状态文件，从上次中断处继续。

howto.what_en: Claude autonomously manages a research project: searches literature, forms hypotheses, runs experiments, records results, periodically synthesizes findings, adjusts direction, and produces a paper and presentation. It does not ask for permission.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a research idea, a clear research question, or want to start an autonomous experiment project.

say_en.text: Research why Transformer attention is inefficient for long sequences.
say_en.note: Claude will search literature, form hypotheses, and start experiment loops.

say_en.text: Resume my paused research on model compression.
say_en.note: Claude reads saved state and continues from where it left off.
